'''December 2001 St. Petersburg tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in St. Petersburg, Florida on 14 December 2001. It is known from Sean Weigold's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3175">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-16-st-petersburg-florida-12-14-01d3175/ st-petersburg-florida-12-14-01], DeckTech (Sean "einnobevoli" Weigold, 16 December 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-16-st-petersburg-florida-12-14-01d3175/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 14 December 2001
* '''Site:''' St. Petersburg, Florida
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
